description: List the release checks an organization runs on every publish, and the checkers it can configure. Each check shows its checker, its effect (inform, or block at a severity), its settings, and how its runs came out over the last 30 days. A secret setting shows as (set), never its value. Call it before publishing to see what will be checked, and fix what you can first. A blocking check refuses a release with a result at or above its severity; an informing check reports and never refuses. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization whose checks to list. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_checks
title: List release checks
